market_summary: Bred AI/tech-rally fortsætter (S&P/Nasdaq nye highs), halvlederrally løfter MRVL/ON/GLW/FLEX, og et hav af Q2-regnskaber (TDG, VRTX, Uber, Aptiv, Insulet, Lennox, DaVita) skaber store enkelt-dags bevægelser i dag. Ingen af dagens nye BULL-kandidater (ON, CRL, O) kan kombineres med et meningsfuldt ATR-sizet køb inden for det tilgængelige kontantbudget ($156.81 ud over 2.500 USD-minimummet), så der åbnes ingen nye positioner. Alle 10 åbne positioner holdes uændret - ingen stop- eller definerede exit-betingelser er brudt, og MMM's fortsatte insider-salg-flag ændrer stadig ikke tesen (samme situation som i går).

decisions.name: Nucor
decisions.reasoning: RSI 77.9 og Bollinger 98% er stærkt overkøbt og momentum divergerer negativt (-13.9), men den bekræftede indtjeningsvending (213. dividendeforhøjelse i træk) og tarif-tailwind holder tesen intakt uden stop- eller exit-brud.
bull: Earnings surged with a 77% increase in EPS last year and a 213th consecutive dividend declared, underscoring a genuine turnaround.
Price is near its 52-week high (-1.9%), confirming a strong uptrend.
bear: RSI 77.9 and Bollinger position 98% mark the stock as very overbought after the run.
Momentum divergence is negative (-13.9), a clear warning the rally is decelerating even as price sits near highs.

investment_plan.thesis: Buy-the-dip i bekræftet bulltrend: KeyBanc-upgrade + Q2-guidance-beat + tarif-rygvind giver asymmetrisk risk/reward.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $222.14 (2x ATR). Sælg ved stålpriskollaps under tarifsatser eller globalt recessions-signal.

decisions.name: Nasdaq, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Fladt prisforløb (-1% 5d) og laveste screener-score i settet, men Verafin/D-Wave-partnerskabet og det afsluttede patentopgør understøtter stadig den fundamentale tese uden nogen exit-trigger.
bull: Diversified, recurring-revenue fintech/data business with a new Verafin-D-Wave partnership adding a quantum-computing financial-crime-detection angle.
Broader tech sector strength is providing a supportive backdrop.
bear: Lowest screener score in the deep set (8.5), indicating weak momentum signal relative to peers.
Price action is essentially flat over 5 days (-1%) with no clear catalyst.

investment_plan.thesis: Bekræftet teknisk vending + rekordstærkt IPO-halvår og AI-platform-adoption forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $90.38 (2x ATR). Sælg ved close under stop eller markant eskalering af perpetual-futures-konkurrencetrussel.

decisions.name: TransDigm Group
decisions.reasoning: Q3-resultatet slog forventningerne og guidance blev opjusteret, så tesen om en makrodrevet (ikke selskabsspecifik) selloff er intakt, selvom investorerne fokuserer på margin/M&A-disciplin frem for det aktuelle beat.
bull: Reported strong fiscal Q3 results, and the aerospace-aftermarket business retains a durable competitive moat.
Relatively low realized volatility (RSI 54, near both SMAs) versus the rest of the deep set.
bear: Stock declined despite beating results, with investors specifically focused on margin trajectory and M&A pricing discipline going forward.
-14% from its 52-week high shows some loss of investor confidence even amid strong reported numbers.

investment_plan.thesis: Makro-/oliedrevet industriselloff, ikke selskabsspecifik svaghed - høj-margin aerospace-eftermarkedsforretning forbliver intakt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $1166.19 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller brud på Zacks-opgraderingens antagelser.

decisions.name: Marvell Technology
decisions.reasoning: AI-netværks-genopretningen accelererer og momentum-divergensen er kraftigt positiv (+38.1), hvilket bekræfter tesen om en dyb oversolgt entry i en intakt AI-silicon-vækstcase.
bull: AI networking/communications demand is accelerating and being cited as a key driver of the renewed semiconductor rally.
Momentum divergence is strongly positive (+38.1), confirming real strength behind the +29% five-day move.
bear: Still -36% from its 52-week high, reflecting a severe prior drawdown that hasn't fully reversed.
Margin pressure from uneven segment mix remains an execution risk even as communications recovers.

investment_plan.thesis: Sektor-bred sympati-selloff i chip-komplekset giver dyb oversolgt entry i en langsigtet intakt AI-silicon-vækstcase.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $162.53 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Kina-hukommelseskonkurrencen viser sig strukturel, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: 3M Company
decisions.reasoning: RSI 74.9 og gentaget insider-salg er fortsat forsigtighedsflag ligesom i går, men hverken PFAS-eskalering eller tilbagegang i organisk vækst/guidance - de definerede exit-betingelser - er indtruffet, så tesen står ved magt.
bull: Outperformed the broader market over the past year with Wall Street maintaining a cautiously optimistic view.
Steady uptrend with price near its 52-week high (-1.5%).
bear: RSI 74.9 and Bollinger position 84% show the stock is overbought after a strong run.
An insider (Kevin H. Rhodes) exercised options and immediately sold in the open market, and momentum divergence is negative (-15.4), both cautionary signals.

investment_plan.thesis: Ægte beat-and-raise-regnskab plus nyt Azure-partnerskab holder det tekniske billede bullish.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $167.21 (2x ATR). Sælg ved PFAS/høreværns-retssagsrisiko eskalerer, eller tilbagegang i organisk vækst/guidance.

decisions.name: ServiceNow
decisions.reasoning: Momentum-divergensen er let negativ (-7.5) efter den stærke bounce, men Dan Ives og andre forbliver bullish på subscription-væksten, og hverken stop eller de definerede exit-betingelser er ramt.
bull: Subscription growth and AI monetization remain strong per management, and some prominent analysts (Dan Ives) remain bullish despite the sell-off.
A Q2 2026 investor letter flagged it as a potentially mispriced AI winner after the software sell-off.
bear: Down 23% YTD on AI-competition and valuation concerns that haven't fully resolved.
Momentum divergence is negative (-7.5), suggesting the recent bounce (+8.8% 20d) may be losing steam.

investment_plan.thesis: Kapitulationstesen fuldt bekræftet og overgået - Q2-beat, opjusteret guidance og fornyet agentic-AI-rotation.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $102.54 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis udmattelses-spiken reverserer skarpt, eller ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse.

decisions.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
decisions.reasoning: Opjusteret 2026-omsætningsudsigt på CF-franchise-vækst og diversificering understøtter tesen, selvom et blandet EPS-print og Sionna-konkurrencetruslen er værd at holde øje med.
bull: Raised its 2026 revenue outlook on CF franchise growth, newer products, and a near-term renal launch, with UBS and RBC both reiterating positive views ahead of pipeline catalysts.
Diversification beyond cystic fibrosis reduces single-franchise concentration risk.
bear: Q2 EPS missed estimates even as revenue beat, a mixed signal worth watching.
Biotech pipeline catalysts carry binary trial/regulatory risk.

investment_plan.thesis: Dybt oversolgt i en teknisk intakt opadgående trend, med Crinetics-opkøb som signal om offensiv pipeline-udvidelse.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $448.95 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis Crinetics-opkøbet viser overbetaling/integrationsproblemer, eller ved pipeline-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Flex Ltd.
decisions.reasoning: AI-drevet kontraktfremstillings-medvind (spejlet af Jabils 31.6%-stigning) og en stærkt positiv momentum-divergens (+26.9) bekræfter at rallyet har reel styrke.
bull: AI-driven contract manufacturing demand (mirrored by peer Jabil's 31.6% six-month surge) is lifting the whole group, and analysts remain bullish on Flex specifically.
Momentum divergence is strongly positive (+26.9), confirming the rally has real underlying strength.
bear: Still -12% below its SMA50 despite the +18% five-day rally, showing high realized volatility.
Volume ratio is below average (0.56x), so the move lacks strong volume confirmation.

investment_plan.thesis: Beat-and-raise-regnskab ignoreret af markedet i en bred tech-selloff giver en dybt oversolgt entry.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $85.68 (2x ATR). Sælg ved selskabsspecifik indtjeningsskuffelse eller fortsat makrodrevet selloff uden bundtegn.

decisions.name: Corning Inc.
decisions.reasoning: Den stærkeste momentum-divergens i settet (+41.2) og potentielle polysilicon-toldsatser/prisgulve er positive, men der mangler stadig en selskabsspecifik katalysator - ingen exit-trigger er ramt.
bull: Momentum divergence is strongly positive (+41.2), the strongest reading in the deep set, suggesting building underlying strength.
Potential tariffs/price floors on imported polysilicon could favor domestic optical/glass supply chains Corning participates in.
bear: Still -13% below SMA50 despite the recent rally, reflecting high realized volatility.
No direct company-specific catalyst in recent headlines — the move looks more sector/momentum-driven than fundamentals-driven.

investment_plan.thesis: Skarp rebound drevet af AI-datacenter-optisk-efterspørgsel og en sektorbred halvlederrally efter et brutalt guidance-drevet fald.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $108.87 (2x ATR). Sælg hvis dagens rally reverserer uden opfølgning, eller ved yderligere guidance-skuffelse.

decisions.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
decisions.reasoning: 20%-rallyet er understøttet af sund (ikke ekstrem) momentum og bred AI/cloud-optimisme; dagens -1.7% er blot profit-taking uden at bryde tesen eller stoppet.
bull: Strong 20% five-day rally with a bullish Street view (one CIO sees S&P 500 climbing to $8,000 partly on names like Amazon).
RSI 61.7 and positive MACD show healthy, not yet extreme, momentum.
bear: -1.7% today shows some profit-taking after the sharp rally.
AI capex/competitive dynamics among Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet remain a swing factor for sentiment.

investment_plan.thesis: Regnskabsdrevet breakout bekræfter AI-monetisering på tværs af cloud og retail; køber en lille startposition inden for det stramme kontantbudget efter dagens CSGP-salg.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Stop ved $253.07 (2x ATR, lige under dagens breakout-niveau). Sælg ved skarp reversal uden opfølgning eller selskabsspecifik skuffelse.
